tasks.title: Initialize Prospector Agent Project Structure
tasks.description: Set up the foundational Node.js project structure with TypeScript, environment configuration, and core dependencies.
tasks.details: Create package.json with Node.js/TypeScript setup. Install dependencies: express, redis, google-maps-api, dotenv, jest. Set up TypeScript config, ESLint, and basic project structure with src/, tests/, and config/ directories.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project compiles successfully, all dependencies are installed, and basic structure is in place.

tasks.title: Create Configuration Management System
tasks.description: Implement the All-Purpose Pattern configuration system that accepts ANY industry/location combination without hardcoded limitations.
tasks.details: Create ProspectorConfig interface and validation. Support dynamic industry queries, location parameters, custom search terms, and business types. Use environment variables and JSON configuration files.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test configuration validation with various industry/location combinations. Verify no hardcoded limitations exist.

tasks.title: Implement Google Places API Integration
tasks.description: Build the core Google Places API (New) integration with Text Search and Nearby Search endpoints.
tasks.details: Implement Google Places API client with proper authentication. Support Text Search for keyword-based discovery and Nearby Search for location-based discovery. Handle API responses and error cases.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test with real API calls for both search types. Mock API responses for unit testing.

tasks.title: Build Dynamic Query Generation Engine
tasks.description: Create intelligent query generation that adapts to any industry and location without limitations.
tasks.details: Implement query builder that constructs search terms from industry keywords, location data, and business categories. Support multiple query strategies and optimization based on results.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test query generation with diverse industry/location inputs. Verify queries produce relevant results.

tasks.title: Implement Redis Lead Deduplication System
tasks.description: Build Redis-based deduplication to prevent storing duplicate leads and optimize storage.
tasks.details: Use Redis sets/hashes to track discovered leads by phone, email, or business name. Implement fast lookup and duplicate checking before storage.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test deduplication logic with simulated lead discovery to ensure duplicates are not stored and unique leads are persisted.

tasks.title: Create Universal Output Manager
tasks.description: Standardize all discovered leads into the ProspectedLead output format and prepare for downstream integration.
tasks.details: Implement the ProspectedLead TypeScript interface. Map all source data into this format. Ensure all required fields are populated and output is consistent.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test output formatting with sample data from all supported sources. Validate schema compliance.

tasks.title: Implement Quality Scoring and Field Masking
tasks.description: Score leads based on data completeness and optimize API usage with field masking.
tasks.details: Develop a scoring algorithm that evaluates completeness of contact info and other key fields. Adjust API requests to only fetch necessary fields. Store qualityScore in ProspectedLead.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test scoring logic with leads of varying completeness. Verify API requests only include required fields.

tasks.title: Add Rate Limiting, Exponential Backoff, and Cost Optimization
tasks.description: Ensure compliance with Google API rate limits, implement exponential backoff, and monitor API usage for cost control.
tasks.details: Implement request throttling and exponential backoff for failed requests. Track API usage and enforce 10,000 calls/month limit. Log and alert when nearing quota.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate high-volume requests and verify rate limiting, backoff, and quota enforcement. Monitor logs for correct usage tracking.

tasks.title: Integrate Apify Google Maps Actors for High-Volume Fallback
tasks.description: Automatically switch to Apify actors when Google Places API quota is exceeded or for large-scale operations.
tasks.details: Detect when API quota is reached. Trigger Apify actor runs via their API. Parse and standardize Apify results into ProspectedLead format. Ensure seamless fallback and recovery.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test by simulating quota exhaustion and verifying Apify fallback triggers and results are processed correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Scheduler and Monitoring
tasks.description: Automate discovery cycles using Vercel cron jobs and set up performance monitoring.
tasks.details: Configure Vercel cron jobs based on user schedule. Monitor uptime, API success rate, processing speed, and deduplication rate. Log metrics for analysis and alert on anomalies.
tasks.testStrategy: Functional test scheduled runs and verify monitoring metrics are collected and reported as specified.
